# WooCommerce Website Scraper

> Extract products, categories or payment methods from a woocommerce store.

- Actor: data_foundry/woocommerce-scraper
- URL: https://apify.com/data_foundry/woocommerce-scraper
- Publisher: Data Foundry (https://apify.com/data_foundry)
- Category: E-commerce
- Pricing: $1.50 per 1,000 items; pay per event, no subscription, failures not billed
- Input: store URL, optional filters and limit
- Output: products, categories or payment methods as JSON
- Run: apify call data_foundry/woocommerce-scraper
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_foundry~woocommerce-scraper/runs
- More actors: https://apify.com/data_foundry
